name: scan-freshness-guard
body: The recorded-scan and freshness surface: `rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh` reads the recorded scan from `graph.jsonl` line 1 (`rust.apg.git.state.recorded_scan`, keyed by `rust.apg.git.state.content_key`); `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` takes the fast path before any frontend or rebuild; `rust.apg.git.commit.reanchor_scan_meta` rewrites line 1 after a durable commit without touching the DB's `Scan` row. Together they are how a re-anchored line makes a diverged DB look fresh.
